description: This file contains an abstract class 'AbstractMessageMapper' which implements the 'MessageMapper' interface. It provides common functionality for message mappers, including handling of an ID, incoming and outgoing conditions, content type blocklist, and a configuration method that initializes these fields from a provided configuration object.

classes.name: AbstractMessageMapper
classes.description: An abstract implementation of the MessageMapper interface that provides common properties and configuration logic for message mappers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message mapper.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the incoming message conditions as a map.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the outgoing message conditions as a map.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the collection of content types that are blocked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initializes the mapper’s properties based on the provided mapping configuration and mapper-specific configuration.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: A protected method intended to be overridden by subclasses to implement custom configuration logic.
